name: Ice Storm
summary: 20-foot-radius Cylinder of hail: Dex save, 2d10 Bludgeoning + 4d6 Cold (half on a success); the ground turns difficult.
text: Hail pounds down in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the Cylinder makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Bludgeoning damage and 4d6 Cold damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The hailstones make the ground in the Cylinder Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the Bludgeoning damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4.
